covariates.ret: log adjusted-close difference, daily total return
covariates.mkt: equal-weighted mean of same-day constituent returns
covariates.vol60: annualised std of the 60 daily returns ending at t, inclusive of day t: shift by one day before using it to explain day t
covariates.mom121: log return from t-252 to t-21, closed before day t
covariates.beta252: 252-day market-model beta vs the equal-weighted index, window ending at t inclusive of day t: shift by one day before using it to explain day t
